title: Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) online reinforcement learning for real robots must absorb human interventions quickly while continuing to improve beyond the human prior. We present a training method for this setting based on two components. First, an \emph{MC Q-chunk} critic regresses chunk-level action values onto Monte Carlo returns from the replay buffer, performing sample-average (behavior) policy evaluation so that intervention trajectories are credited directly rather than diluted by current-policy TD backups. Second, \emph{max-Q selective imitation} updates the actor by imitating, at each state, the higher-$Q$ action between the current policy action and a buffer sample under a hard winner-take-all rule. translated_title: 最大Q选择性模仿用于人在回路在线机器人学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15088v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对于真实机器人，人在回路（HIL）在线强化学习必须快速吸收人类干预，同时继续超越人类先验知识进行改进。我们提出了一种针对此场景的训练方法，包含两个组件。首先，一个\emph{MC Q-chunk}评论家将块级动作值回归到来自回放缓冲区的蒙特卡洛回报上，执行样本平均（行为）策略评估，从而直接对干预轨迹进行奖励，而不是被当前策略的时序差分备份稀释。其次，\emph{最大Q选择性模仿}通过在每个状态下，在当前策略动作和缓冲区样本之间，以硬赢者通吃规则模仿具有更高Q值的动作来更新演员。该规则自动在从干预学习和基于策略的自我改进之间切换：当自主策略更强时，目标与策略分布对齐，减少了否则会出现的策略-目标样本差距。
tldr: 该方法通过蒙特卡洛Q块评论家直接评估人类干预，并用最大Q选择性模仿在干预学习和自主改进间自动切换，实现了高效的人机协同在线机器人学习。
en_tdlr: This method uses a Monte Carlo Q-chunk critic to directly credit human interventions and max-Q selective imitation to automatically switch between learning from interventions and self-improvement, enabling efficient human-in-the-loop online robot learning.
